commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
90+5' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Andy Diouf (Lens) heads on.
90+4' Florian Sotoca (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

90+3' Florian Sotoca (Lens) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Alexandre Oukidja shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+2' Andy Diouf (Lens) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Andy Diouf (Lens) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
86' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' Wesley Said (Lens) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
84' Alexandre Oukidja blocks Andy Diouf (Lens)'s effort from the edge of the box.
83' Wesley Said (Lens) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the left post.
82' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
80' Andy Diouf (Lens) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
79' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stephanie Frappart has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

79' Faitout Maouassa (Lens) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
77' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle and it's Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
75' A long pass, executed by Jonathan Gradit (Lens), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
74' Wesley Said (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) replaces Cheikh Sabaly.
73' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Elye Wahi will be replaced by Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
73' The substitution has been made. Habib Maiga (Metz) has replaced Lamine Camara.
72' The substitution is prepared. Andy Diouf (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Abdukodir Khusanov.
72' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' A cross from Florian Sotoca (Lens) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
69' The resulting corner from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is cleared by the defence.
66' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Elye Wahi (Lens) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
64' Fali Cande (Metz) picks up a yellow card.
64' Elye Wahi (Lens) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
63' That will be all from Deiver Machado who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Faitout Maouassa (Lens).
63' Substitution. Angelo Fulgini makes his way off the pitch and Wesley Said (Lens) comes on as his replacement.
63' It will be a substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Aguilar walks off.
62' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Simon Elisor (Metz) replacing Oscar Estupinan.
62' The referee signals a substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Joel Asoro.
61' Florian Sotoca (Lens) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ruben Aguilar.

58' Elye Wahi (Lens) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alexandre Oukidja shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
57' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
56' He should have scored! Angelo Fulgini (Lens) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
53' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
52' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
52' Florian Sotoca (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
50' Elye Wahi (Lens) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
48' A player from Lens commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
47' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
46' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
45+1' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

44' Elye Wahi (Lens) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Alexandre Oukidja anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target.
43' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post.
42' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
40' Deiver Machado (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
39' The game is interrupted now, Deiver Machado (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Matthieu Udol plays it into the box, and Joel Asoro (Metz) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the middle of the net. 0:1.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
34' Deiver Machado (Lens) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.

33' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
33' A yellow card for a tackle by Joel Asoro (Metz). Stephanie Frappart doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
28' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
26' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
25' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Lens.
25' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
23' The foul by Adrien Thomasson (Lens) was seen by Stephanie Frappart who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
21' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner which is cleared.
19' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
17' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' Elye Wahi (Lens) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alexandre Oukidja sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post. The ball is out of play. Lens will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' It's a nice effort by Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Alexandre Oukidja. Easy save.
13' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is adjudged offside.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lens comes to nothing.
9' Wow, what an escape. Elye Wahi (Lens) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.

7' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
6' Lens fail to score from a corner as Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) leaps to collect the ball.
6' Deiver Machado (Lens) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
4' The ball is cleared after Koffi Kouao (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
